description: Use when traffic does not reach a workload in Kubernetes although its pods are running: a Service with no endpoints, a wrong selector or targetPort, connection refused or time-outs between pods, DNS names that do not resolve (NXDOMAIN, "server can't find"), a NetworkPolicy blocking traffic, or an Ingress or Gateway API route that does not route. Investigates with kubectl get and describe, asks before checks inside a container, and proposes fixes. Reads first and asks before changing anything.
